title: Power Rankings: Suns stumble to No. 2; Wizards drop six spots
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 14
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: 25-2 since Dec. 11, 15 straight wins at home, 27-6 vs. West teams ... and swimming in fresh vengeance fuel after Josh Howard's omission as an All-Star reserve.
rankings.summaryText: 25-2 since Dec. 11, 15 straight wins at home, 27-6 vs. West teams ... and swimming in fresh vengeance fuel after Josh Howard's omission as an All-Star reserve.

rankings.summaryHtml: Dropping to 0-3 vs. Utah is undeniably disconcerting, but not as troubling for Suns as facing 35 more games with a seven-man rotation and injuries starting to crop up.

rankings.summaryHtml: You usually don't promote teams that just lost their top scorer for a month. But Jazz, after blowing five fourth-quarter leads in January, also just beat Spurs and Suns.

rankings.summaryHtml: In their last two title seasons? In '02-03, Spurs were also 32-16 after 48 games. Yet in '04-05, they were a tidy 38-10, six games ahead of Mavs instead of seven behind.

rankings.summaryHtml: Kobe gets suspended! Kobe hears an MVP chant in Boston! Kobe grills Arenas! Kobe seethes seeing LeBron avoid suspension! And this crazy trip is only half over.

rankings.summaryHtml: Warriors were widely proclaimed winners in the big trade last month with Indy, but it's Pacers who have won six of seven to go a season-high five games over .500.

rankings.summaryHtml: I was wrong: Simmons did write Wiz would win their division before the season began. Yet I think we'd all agree Wiz better see a swift return from Jamison to stay there.

rankings.summaryHtml: Two games over .500? Three-game division lead? The committee is getting ahead of ourselves, true, but can't help dreaming of Canada in the spring (and in the playoffs).

rankings.summaryHtml: Since stumbling to a bad loss in Atlanta on Jan. 6, Clips are 9-4. The next five games, all roadies in the East, should tell us if this is going to be a lasting recovery.

rankings.summaryHtml: Heat look a lot more serious since surrendering 52 points to Knicks' Crawford. Maybe that woke up the champs like their big loss in Dallas around this time last season.

rankings.summaryHtml: Not sure who might be the new scapegoat in Minny: Wolves are 2-5 since Casey's firing and a deflating 0-3 since so impressively halting Suns' 17-game win streak.

rankings.summaryHtml: Since going a season-high 10 games over .500, Cavs have dropped eight of 12 ... and their best game in that stretch, strangely, was the one LeBron sat out injured.

rankings.summaryHtml: Wouldn't it be something if injury-riddled Hornets, who unraveled late last season, kept rallying all the way back into contention this season now that Paul is back?
